name: The Basantapur Railing
description: A grand staircase railing built around flowing spirals that curl and unfurl like a river bend. Every twist is heated over an open flame and beaten into shape by a Nepali karigar's hammer, one loop at a time - no two panels ever come out exactly alike. Made in Nepal, for Nepali homes that want a staircase people stop to admire.
material: 10mm MS rod (hand-forged scroll), 1"x1" MS pipe frame, 1" MS flat bar (patti)
note: Wood handrail shown is not included - iron scrollwork only.
features: Red oxide primer & Black matt deco paint finish
